# Colecto v0.5.4

Extension API versions now actually count. If you don't write extensions, nothing in
this release changes anything for you, and you can go back to your inbox.

## Extension API versions

- **Numbers that mean something.** Until now every extension said `api_version = 1`
  and the contract quietly changed under it during the alpha. From now on, every change
  to the extension API gets the next number: 1, 2, 3, and so on. Colecto runs
  extensions on any version it still supports, so you only need to bump yours when you
  want something new. See
  [API versions](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.5.4/docs/extensions/api-versions/README.md).
- **API 2: the version that does nothing.** It adds nothing, removes nothing and
  changes nothing. It is API 1 wearing a name tag that says "we're counting now".
  Your API 1 extensions keep working. If you like round numbers, change `1` to `2` and
  enjoy the identical behaviour.
- **API 3: dots in bus names.** Extensions that target API 3 can name bus requests
  and events with dots, such as `v0.1.2/add_button`. We still strongly recommend
  whole-number versions (`v1/add_button`, `v2/add_button`), which is what the bundled
  extensions use. See
  [Bundled bus surfaces](https://github.com/hexvale-labs/colecto/blob/v0.5.4/docs/extensions/bundled-bus.md).
- **Old extensions explain themselves.** If a future release has to drop an API
  version, Colecto won't silently break extensions that use it. It tells you which
  extension can't be loaded and links to that release's notes, which will say why.
  No version is dropped in this release.
